description: This Java class, LoopSubContentTransform, implements a FreeMarker template transform. It processes and renders related content and sub-content in a web application, particularly for content association and display within templates. It manages context preparation, content retrieval, and optional wrapping with templates for rendering sub-content URLs or links.

classes.name: LoopSubContentTransform
classes.description: Implements a FreeMarker template transform to process and render sub-content links, managing context, content association, and optional wrapping for display.
